conclusion.statement: The evidentiary record states that Summit was incorporated on January 10, 2018; Summit claimed an S election effective January 1, 2019, filed Form 2553 on March 22, 2022, and received an IRS CP261 notice confirming approval for the identified effective date; Summit distributed $11,000 on March 15, 2019; and a due-diligence memorandum reports that Gregory A. Beaumont transferred 100,000 shares to Canadian resident Carrie Canuck on June 1, 2022.
